Event-type model for an interval-censored outcome

Source: R/survivalSub.R
fit_event_type_interval.Rd

The competing-risks part of survivalSub(): a logistic model for the event type among subjects whose event was observed (finite R). The event type is taken as known once the event is detected, but the event time is not, so a model that uses it needs the event_time column filled for those subjects (fitIntervalBJM() fills it with imputed times and refits this model every iteration).

Usage

fit_event_type_interval(
  data,
  form_marginal_surv,
  form_conditional_cr,
  event_time
)
